## Contributor Checklist

Please verify before submitting:

- [ ] I have modified only files in `categories/*.txt`.
- [ ] I have NOT created, edited, or committed `exclude-list.txt` (GitHub Actions generates it automatically).
- [ ] I have run `./scripts/test.sh` locally and all tests passed.
- [ ] The proposed patterns do not over-block public web content (documentation, news, articles).
